text:
Both melting and boiling of water require an input of energy.
What happens to the temperature of water during melting and boiling?
A
Temperature rises during both melting and boiling.
B
Temperature does not change during melting, but rises during boiling.
C
Temperature rises during melting, but does not change during boiling.
D
Temperature remains unchanged during melting and during boiling.

options.label: A
options.text: Temperature rises during both melting and boiling.

options.label: B
options.text: Temperature does not change during melting, but rises during boiling.

options.label: C
options.text: Temperature rises during melting, but does not change during boiling.

options.label: D
options.text: Temperature remains unchanged during melting and during boiling.
